title: Luma Uni-1.1 Unified Intelligence API
summary: Luma Uni-1.1 is a production-grade multimodal intelligence API that utilizes a unified reasoning architecture for high-precision image generation and editing. It supports complex tasks like multi-reference grounding with up to 9 inputs and natural-language image modification.
research_notes: Utilizes a reasoning-first approach where the model plans compositions before rendering; currently integrated by industry leaders including Adobe and Freepik.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from the Dream Machine video model (2024) and Ray2 multimodal architecture (2025) into a unified autoregressive transformer system. The Uni-1.1 update released in May 2026 transitioned the technology into a production-ready API with superior spatial reasoning and multilingual text rendering.
